I made a cool outdoor jukebox for my party patio. Here's how.

  1. Had a crappy old Samsung 19" television with a half-busted screen my mother was going to throw away.

  2. Had an old Windows XP laptop with dead batteries my sister gave me.

  3. Bought a wireless mouse from Wal-Mart for $9.

  4. I installed Xubuntu, cut it down to just browser and wifi, have it boot straight to Firefox with http://player.liquidcompass.net/KBPAFM as the homepage. Changed BIOS to boot the machine every time electrical power comes on.

  5. Took the screen off the old laptop and ran VGA and headphone output sound to the old TV.

  6. Used wood screws to bolt this whole business to a piece of plywood with a power strip on it. Screwed that whole mess to the wall under the eave of my house to protect it from rain.

Benefit: I can sit at my patio table and click the bookmark tab of various streams of http://Last.fm and radio stations, or crank up Clementine with the wireless mouse. (Could stream movies from my HTPC, but the screen is half gone on this TV).

When it's time for bed, I flip the power switch on the power strip and walk in the house. No vampire loads. No wet electricity running around the patio when I'm away.
How I made an outdoor jukebox for $9.

Caveat: Laptops usually have their WiFi antenna wire run through the folding hinge and up the side of the monitor.

Be careful when using a hacksaw or whatever to cut off the laptop hinges. When you remove the monitor, shove that antenna wire somewhere inside the keyboard part of the machine.

A year before his death in 1982, Rainer Werner Fassbinder compiled a list of his 10 favorite films by other directors and his favorite 10 of his own films.

Fassbinder's 10 favorite films by other directors

  1. The Damned (1969) - Luchino Visconti
  2. The Naked and the Dead (1958) - Raoul Walsh
  3. Lola Montès (1955) - Max Ophuls
  4. Flamingo Road (1949) - Michael Curtiz
  5. Salò, or The 120 Days of Sodom (1975) - Pier Paolo Pasolini
  6. Gentlemen Prefer Blondes (1953) - Howard Hawks
  7. Dishonored (1931) - Josef von Sternberg
  8. The Night of the Hunter (1955) - Charles Laughton
  9. Johnny Guitar (1954) - Nicholas Ray
  10. The Red Snowball Tree (1974) - Vasily Shukshin

Fassbinder's favorite 10 of his own films

  1. Beware of a Holy Whore (1971)
  2. In a Year with 13 Moons (1978)
  3. Despair (1978)
  4. The Third Generation (1979)
  5. Gods of the Plague (1970)
  6. Martha (1974)
  7. Effi Briest (1974)
  8. Ali: Fear Eats the Soul (1974)
  9. The Marriage of Maria Braun (1979)
  10. The Merchant of Four Seasons (1971)
